name: Orangepeel, Onionskin
source:
For twenty years, Mona has prepared to deliver the god that sleeps in Lave's belly.

Now, four nights, and four rituals, remain.

[From [url=https://godaughtr.itch.io/orangepeel-onionskin]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
二十年来，莫娜一直准备拯救沉睡在莱夫腹中的神。

现在，还剩下四个夜晚和四个仪式。

[来自[url=https://godaughtr.itch.io/orangepeel-onionskin]itch.io[/url]]
